What I also loved is how kid-friendly and family-friendly the place felt, making it easy to enjoy a…

Hanoi Train Street offers one of the most memorable experiences in the city. What looks like an ordinary railway becomes a vibrant, photogenic spot thanks to the way local residents have transformed it with charm and creativity. The narrow lane is lined with small cafés, each with its own vibe, where visitors sip drinks, take photos, enjoy music, and soak in the energy of the place. The welcoming attitude of the…

Hanoi Train Street has two sections. The Old Quarter side (northern side) and the Lê Duẩn Street side (southern side). Both are worth visiting, but the Old Quarter section, which attracts most tourists, has become overly commercialized. Apart from the rude and inconsiderate visitors, many café owners there seem more focused on making money than offering genuine hospitality. In contrast, the southern side stands out…

前から気になっていて やっと来れました。 駐車場がちょっと狭いので、大きい車は難しいかもです。 店内はとても素敵な雰囲気で、古い建物ながら小綺麗にされて掃除が行き届いています。 お手洗いもリフォームされたのか綺麗でした。 店主のお婆様が、良い意味で田舎のおばあちゃんって感じの明るい方で、 お店にかかってきた電話を大きな声でお友達？と話していて、ご自身のご病気の事をお話していました。 一流の接客ではなく、親戚感がある感じです笑 私は全然気になりませんが、人によってはビックリしちゃうかもしれません。 でも、電話が終わってから「年寄り同士の会話だから相手も耳が聞こえなくて大きな声になっちゃってごめんなさいね😆」と仰ってくださいました。 本当に気にならないので、大丈夫ですよ(´∨`)と言ったら笑ってくださいました。 お食事ですが、アイスコーヒーとチーズトーストを頂きました。…

One point to note is that if you buy too much, your luggage for the return flight will exceed the weight limit. Take plenty of time…

2479.aj: 〒415-0029 静岡県下田市田牛龍宮窟
2479.ed: Round sea cave known for the large hole in its roof & panoramic ocean views from the crater edge.
2479.edj: 円形の海食洞。屋根に大きな天窓があることで知られる。天窓の端からは海を眺望できる。

rv.t: I recommend checking the tide schedule and visiting during high tide to capture images with greater depth and visual layering. Although it is hot outside, the cave is cool; however, it is very humid and the ground can be slippery, so I do not advise elderly people or children to visit unaccompanied. There are staff members directing traffic in the spacious parking lot, and restroom facilities are available on-site.

Arrived after 4pm so parking was free. But if I had to pay 500 yen for this I'd be highly disappointed. The beach area is now cordoned off and all the people on the sand basically ignores it. Yes its nice but it is a very short stop. Recommend arriving after 4pm when parking is free.

A unique and beautiful natural sea cave with a large skylight and ocean views — great for photos. • Easy access from a small parking area for a reasonable fee (≈¥500), with restrooms nearby. • Visitors enjoy walking around the top viewpoints for panoramic ocean scenes. • Considered a hidden gem that can be enjoyed in under an hour. - From Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 #VisitSriLanka

2480.a: Ohtago Beach, 2649-2 Tago, Nishiizu, Kamo District, Shizuoka 410-3515, Japan
2480.aj: 〒410-3515 静岡県賀茂郡西伊豆町田子２６４９−２ 大田子海岸
2480.ed: Visitors say this tourist destination offers stunning views of the sunset and the unique "Godzilla Rock" formation. They also highlight the peaceful atmosphere, with both locals and tourists enjoying the scenery. Guests mention that parking is readily available on weekdays.
2480.edj: この観光地を訪れた人は、夕日の素晴らしい景色と珍しい「ゴジラ岩」の形を高く評価しています。また、地元の人も観光客も景色を楽しんでいて、穏やかな雰囲気が特徴のようです。平日は駐車場が利用しやすいというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: What a sunset it was! First of all, the atmosphere alone was an experience. Locals and tourist alike peacefully waiting for the moment. Photographers quietly setting up their station. It felt like being part of sth bigger. The local photography club members were there and they were happy to welcome everyone with a nice chat. I’ve been coming to japan for over a decade and this is truly one very memorable sunset.
ここから見るメガネっちょ（ゴジラ岩）と夕陽は絶景。いつも10人くらい人がいて写真を撮っている
素敵な景色です。 今度夕日を見に行きたいです

2481.a: Koganezaki Park, 3566-7 Ugusu, Nishiizu, Kamo District, Shizuoka 410-3501, Japan
2481.aj: 〒410-3501 静岡県賀茂郡西伊豆町宇久須３５６６−７ 黄金崎公園
2481.ed: Overlook & small promenade for views of ocean sunsets, Mt. Fuji & a unique horse-shaped rock.
2481.edj: 遊歩道と展望台がある公園。海に沈む夕日、富士山、馬の顔に見える奇岩の景色が楽しめる。

rv.t: A nice and and serene place. Need to drive to the top to enjoy the view. There's also a rock that shaped like a horse head. It is a natural rock formation. The view looking out to the sea is superb. There's a small cafe for people to relax and enjoy the place.

Stopover at Koganezaki Park. Famous for its dramatic coastal cliffs, this scenic cape rewards visitors with breathtaking views of Suruga Bay and, on clear days, even Mount Fuji in the distance. The highlight is the iconic “Horse Rock,” a unique rock formation shaped like a horse’s head, making it one of the most photographed spots along the Izu coastline.

You can observe the magnificent and spectacular nature of Izu. The horse-shaped rock here is called Uma Rock, and in Japan, it's said to be a lucky rock that brings victory in horse racing. It was a truly beautiful place.

2482.a: Marugen, 1 Chome-4-1 Shishido, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0004, Japan
2482.aj: 〒414-0004 静岡県伊東市猪戸１丁目４−１ まるげん
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2482.ed: Japanese-style seafood & fish dishes, sashimi & rice bowls a cozy, unfussy eatery.
2482.edj: くつろいだ雰囲気の簡素な居酒屋。和の海鮮料理、刺身、丼などを提供。

rv.t: Fine dinning here, the front desk was very warmhearted, introduced a lot about how the set and dishes are supposed to be dealt with. Sake from the local, called Snow something, very tasty, with huge amount of sweetness. Set of golden eye fish is a good choice to experience the Izu. Some dishes may be too salty for tourists, bring in more good rice, I can only give this advice. Come earlier, otherwise u have to wait…
Well is it really that hard these days to translate menu into English? Forcing us to choose from a very limited menu instead. Only fish of course. Lots of other places to eat round here though.

Food is mediocre according to my other companions. Ordered their highly recommended beef rice. Apparently, their dish had more vegetables than the beef itself. Moreover, the dish was spicy and there was 0 warning. Generally very disappointed by my dish and will not order again.

2482.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2483.a: Japan, 〒414-0001 Shizuoka, Itō, Usami, 1999/hotel 字初津2811番地4
2483.aj: 〒414-0001 静岡県伊東市宇佐美1999/hotel 字初津2811番地4

rv.t: 大きな窓から海を眺めることができる素敵なお部屋でした。 インテリアがどれもとても可愛くオシャレで、非日常のゆったりした時間を過ごすことができました。 部屋もとても清潔で、電子レンジやトースター、ドライヤーなど必要な家電類も使いやすいものが揃っていて、お洒落なだけでなくとても快適です。 テレビはないのですが、代わりにとても素敵な本と大きなスピーカーが置いてあり、デジタルデトックスにも最適です。 いつかまた泊まりに来たいと思える、思い出のホテルになりました！
部屋から見える景色がとてもよかったです！！ 部屋に立派なスピーカーがあり、好きな音楽をかけながら海を眺め非常にリフレッシュできました。 食事はついていませんが駅やコンビニ、周辺飲食店も徒歩圏内にあったので特に不自由なく過ごせました。 ホテルの目の前が海岸なので朝のんびり散歩するのもおすすめです！

3階のお部屋に泊まらせていただきました。 屋上にはサウナもついています！ お部屋のスピーカーで音楽を楽しんだり、目の前の海を眺めながらぼーっと波音に耳をすませたり。 ｢何もしない｣を贅沢に楽しめる時間でした。 朝は早起きを頑張ることをおすすめします！ 目を覚ましてすぐに綺麗なグラデーションが見えます。 目の前の宇佐美海水浴場まで降りてぼーっと朝日を眺める時間も贅沢でした。 またこちらのホテルから、違う季節の海も観てみたいです。

2484.a: Bamboo Forest Path, 3458-6 Shuzenji, Izu, Shizuoka 410-2416, Japan
2484.aj: 〒410-2416 静岡県伊豆市修善寺３４５８−６ 竹林の小径
catj: ハイキング コース
2484.ed: Tranquil pathway slicing through a bamboo grove, with a clearing for relaxing & nearby cafes.
2484.edj: 竹林の中に伸びる静かな小径。くつろげるちょっとした休憩場所用意されている。近くにはカフェもある。

rv.t: I really love the bamboo forest and this area. There is a free foot onsen which is very relaxing. There are not many restaurants or cafes around.This is because not many people live in this area. But I personally love how quiet and peaceful it is. The atmosphere feels calm and natural. It is a perfect place to escape from the busy city. Walking around here makes me feel refreshed and relaxed. I also really love the…

Visited at 6pm in early June when everything was shut and no tourists (except us) making it very peaceful and had the whole place to ourselves. Cooler in the evening so we could enjoy the hot foot baths and listen the river. Beautiful
Visiting it at the right period of the year (Autumn) where there are beautiful autumn leaves with river nearby, makes it even more beautiful! This place (Shuzenji)is really worth a visit!

2485.a: Shuzenji Temple, 964 Shuzenji, Izu, Shizuoka 410-2416, Japan
2485.aj: 〒410-2416 静岡県伊豆市修善寺９６４ 修禅寺
2485.ed: Small, hilltop temple with bamboo groves, cherry blooms in spring & outdoor summer concerts.
2485.edj: 竹林の小径がある丘の上の小さな寺。春には桜が咲き、夏には野外コンサートが行われる。

rv.t: Shuzenji Temple & Onsen A stunning onsen town a bamboo forest and wasabi ice cream but a tragic history. If you’re looking for an outstanding onsen (hot spring) town, then head to Shuzenji Onsen, a few hours’ train ride from Tokyo in the prefecture of Shizuoka. Although it’s nicknamed Izu’s “Little Kyoto,” it’s more than just that. Over the years, Shuzenji’s unique history has also inspired travelers and Japanese…

We were lucky to be there on the anniversary of the death of Kukai. We saw the mikoshi parade, hot spring blessing, and young fish releasing. We ended up staying there all day enjoying the area and event.
IMO this shrine is more interesting and beautiful than several ones that we’ve seen in Tokyo. Very glad that we visited it

2486.a: Hirizo Beach, Nakagi, 南伊豆町 Minamiizu, Kamo District, Shizuoka 415-0311, Japan
2486.aj: 〒415-0311 静岡県賀茂郡南伊豆町中木 ヒリゾ浜
2486.edj: シュノーケリングスポットの海岸。船でしかたどり着けない特別な地理的環境のため、海の透明度が極めて高く、サンゴや季節回遊魚が多い。

rv.t: Probably the best spot for snorkeling around Kanto area. However, you need to get to the port really early like 5am to get a parking lot and put your stuff to secure your spot in a line for a boat. Also, there will be so many people in a small area. A sand area is very limited. Other space is stones and rocks. You must take your chairs and/or air mat. Japanese people like to stay in tents so they’ll block your view.

Superb... Excellent snorkling site outside Okinawa. During peak season this tiny beach will be horrible crowded but at the end of season (September) this tiny beach almost like private beach. Rocky beach has Crystal visibility, plenty various of coral fishes. Marine boot is mandatory, except rock and other sharp objects the beach also has many poisonous Stone fish. Absolutely recommend

The snorkeling area is nice as it's an enclosed area surrounded mostly by rocks. You need to get quite a bit out to be deep enough to swim. You will definitely need some shoes for the water as there's sea urchins and sharp rocks that I would not suggest walking barefoot on. Once you're further out though, the water and marine life is really nice. Biggest negative is how crowded it is and having to arrive super early…

2487.a: Nikonikorentaka Itokotobukichoten, 1-9 Kotobukicho, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0018, Japan
2487.aj: 〒414-0018 静岡県伊東市寿町１−９ ニコニコレンタカー 伊東寿町店

rv.t: 伊豆旅行のため、初めてニコニコレンタカーを利用しました。 伊東駅からもさほど遠くはなくとても便利です。 予定より1時間も早く着いてしまいましたが、親切に対応していただき、手続きも車体の確認含めても15分弱で済みました。 また利用させていただきたいです。 2026/03/20追記 昨今ニコニコレンタカーが話題になっていましたが、こちらの店舗では大変親切に対応していただけました。 何かあると悪いですし、そもそも大手レンタカー会社より格安で借りれるため自分は1番高い保証をつけていました。 実際お借りした車はそこら中にスレや傷があり、借りる前の車両確認の際にはざっと傷の説明(ここもここにも…といった感じで)はしていただきましたが、1番高い保証をつけていたため少しの傷くらいなら保険が効きますので大丈夫ですよ👌と言った感じで全く厳しくありませんでした。 また伊豆旅行に行く際にはこちらを利用させていただきたいと思っています🙏
蒲郡から 今回の東伊豆旅は こちらのニコレンさんで レンタルさせていただきました よい旅になりました♡ ありがとう
SNSでニコレンが槍玉に挙げられてたので書き込み。 ここのニコレンは店員さんが親切で手際もいいです！ 忘れ物をした時も優しく対応していただきました。 ニコレンはひどい！とか言われてますけど、お店によります。このお店はそんなことないので、安心して借りれますよ。

2488.a: ベトナム クアンナム省 ホイアン

2489.a: FLAT HOUSE cafe, 3 Chome-16-2 Chuorinkan, Yamato, Kanagawa 242-0007, Japan
2489.aj: 〒242-0007 神奈川県大和市中央林間３丁目１６−２ FLAT HOUSE cafe
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: モッコウバラと写真が撮りたくて予約して伺いました。ちょうど満開の時期だったので行った日は予約で埋まっていたようで電話がひっきりなしにかかっているようでした。 犬と一緒に来れるということで犬連れの方が多くいるようでした。 リーズナブルで景色も綺麗なので来年もぜひ行きたいです。
ミートローフプレート とても美味しかったです。 ビーフストロガノス 肉多めで、普通に美味しかったです。 コーヒー☕️ アメリカン、とても美味しかったです。
美味しい店でした🙏ご馳走様でした😋注文間違いが有ったけど、結果オーライ👍️ ランチセットとケーキセット、カフェオレ頼んで👛安く抑えられなかった店の１つ💦 平日の11時くらいに着いたと思う。個室を使わせてもらえて✨ラッキー✨２人で４時間くらい粘らせてもらってしまった💦 テーブルが広く、6〜7人でこの個室を狭く利用も楽しそう😃 壁のねじ巻き式時計は止まっているので⚠️

2489.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2490.a: Japan, 〒384-0502 Nagano, Minamisaku District, Sakuho, Ohinata, 592 The Bath & Bed Sakuho
2490.aj: 〒384-0502 長野県南佐久郡佐久穂町大日向５９２ The Bath & Bed Sakuho

rv.t: 昨年夫婦で訪れました。 お風呂もベッドも素敵で、備え付けのシャンプー類は香りが良く、リラックスできました🌼 周辺には、大きな川があったり、神社があったり。故郷じゃないのに、故郷に帰ってきたような懐かしい気持ちになりました。 ふと思い出して、また行きたいな〜という気持ちになったので、クチコミを残します☺️ ゆっくり、心穏やかに過ごしたい方におすすめです🫶
ジブリのような世界観の蔵を一棟借りて、リラックスしたステイでした。 蔵の土壁が呼吸をして、湿度の調整をしてくれているからか、ぐっすりとよく眠れて翌日も元気いっぱいに◎ 食事は付いていませんが、近くに美味しい猪料理の名店やスペシャルティーコーヒー屋さんがあったり、天然温泉もあったりで、五感が大満足する旅になりました。

2491.a: Yamanakako Hana no Miyako Park, 1650 Yamanaka, Yamanakako, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0501, Japan
2491.aj: 〒401-0501 山梨県南都留郡山中湖村山中１６５０ 花の都公園
2491.ed: Lakeside park with views of Mount Fuji across seasonal fields of poppies, sunflowers & tulips.
2491.edj: 湖畔にある公園。ポピー、ヒマワリ、チューリップなど四季折々の花畑の向こうに富士山を一望できる。

rv.t: I absolutely loved this park! It’s a beautiful, spacious area with many different zones to explore. The outdoor flower fields paired with the stunning view of Mount Fuji are breathtaking. I was especially impressed by the waterfall area, which is very serene. There’s also a nice playground, making it a great spot for families with kids. A perfect place to relax, walk around, and take amazing photos. Highly…

What a fun getaway! Local heavy, tourist friendly! Great views of Mt. Fuji and some wonderful scenery including waterfalls, beautiful rock formations, and of course all the flowers! 10/10 for my wife and I! Public transportation was easy to and from this location as well!

Perhaps because it was still early in the momiji season, I didn't get to see very rich autumn leaves in other parts of the Fuji Five Lakes area, but I got to see beautiful autumn leaves in this park! Very beautiful park overall and highly recommended to visit, though note that buses around Yamanakako are scarcer compared to Kawaguchiko and may run quite behind schedule, so it's easier to get around if you have a car.

2492.a: Japan, 〒409-2304 Yamanashi, Minamikoma District, Nambu, Ide, 1425-1 古民家喫茶店油屋
2492.aj: 〒409-2304 山梨県南巨摩郡南部町井出１４２５−１ 古民家喫茶店油屋
2492.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and authentic curry and Napolitan, which features Fujinomiya yakisoba noodles, as well as their flavorful chai. They also highlight the cozy and relaxing atmosphere of the renovated traditional Japanese house. Guests mention the staff are friendly and attentive, and the restrooms are uniquely decorated.
2492.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、本格的なカレーや富士宮やきそばの麺を使ったナポリタン、風味豊かなチャイが高く評価されています。また、改築された古民家の居心地が良く、落ち着いた雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフは親しみやすく、気配りができるという声や、トイレの装飾がユニークだという感想もあります。

rv.t: こんなに日当たりが良くて居心地の良い建物に住んでいた佐野洋子さんが、のちに非情とも思えるような文章を書くのが気になったので、著作を数冊読んでみました。 佐野さんは戦後、9歳の時に大陸から引き揚げて、家族共々叔父のこの家に住まわせてもらっていました。 山梨県には3年間、そのうち油屋にいたのは最初の1年足らずでした。 自伝的小説「右の心臓」には、山梨時代の壮絶なエピソードが収められており、「100万回生きたねこ」の死生観にも繋がっているのが感じられました。 もちろんアブラヤのオッチャン（父の兄）も出て来るし、油屋での暮らしや、地名や地形の描写もたくさん出て来るので、一度このお店に来た方は楽しめると思います。 さて現在のお店の方はというと、雰囲気だけでなく料理の味も見た目も良く、近年最高の穴場カフェの発見となりました。 ですが、ご主人が厨房にこもりっぱなしなのが残念な点でした。玄関に客が来てもしばらく反応が無いのです。…
「100万回生きた猫」の絵本作家佐野洋子さんが幼少期を過ごしたという古民家カフェ 油屋ナポリタンAセット スープ、ラペ、お飲物付きをいただきました 富士宮やきそばの麺を使ったナポリタンがとても美味しかった スパイスのきいたチャイもオススメです はじめに出てくる、クロモジ茶も美味しかったです 照明💡のかさがキリコのグラスやガラスのお皿などを使っていてかわいかった 古民家の雰囲気がとても素敵でした
山梨南部美味しい店で検索ヒット 初来店 カレーセット、ナポリタンセットと注文しました 店の雰囲気も良く食事も美味しい残さず完食😋 感じの良いオーナーで 大満足でした！

2492.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2493.a: Shin-Ōkubo Kankoku Yokochō (Korea alley), 2 Chome-19-1 Okubo, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 169-0072, Japan
2493.aj: 〒169-0072 東京都新宿区大久保２丁目１９−１ 新大久保韓国横丁
catj: ブランチ レストラン
2493.ed: Varied dishes from hot pot to BBQ, plus beer, served in a busy, colorful Korean food hall.
2493.edj: 鍋料理から焼肉まで、さまざまな韓国料理を楽しめる賑やかで色彩豊かなフードホール。ビールもある。

rv.t: Will be hard to find unless you confidently walk in and the store will be at the end of the alley on the far right. No distinct signs since all the other stalls are in one hall. But once you go in, and find it, u’ll be amazed by all the food there. We went for the all you can eat menu(additional ¥500 for the raw marinated shrimp/crab/ salmon and yukhoe). You get an absolute bang for your buck! Around ¥3300 per…

We visited this amazing food hall during our trip to Korean Town and left absolutely stuffed! Inside Korea Alley, there are a handful of different Korean restaurants all throughout the main floor with different Korean food options. Most of them offer very similar items but everything looked delicious as we walked around. We stopped at the last restaurant and ordered numerous Korean dishes. Every single item was so…

Stopped in for dinner with a family friend. Great atmosphere. Got some fried chicken and french fries. Cabbage salad and picked daikon appetizers were placed on the table with no questions asked; charged for them on the bill.

2494.a: Pulau Kelor, Pasir Putih, Komodo, West Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia
2494.aj: Pulau Kelor, Pasir Putih, Komodo, 西マンガライ県 ヌサトゥンガラティムール インドネシア

rv.t: This place is amazing.... Its my first time swimming very close to baby shark. They just swim around you. You can just take pics of them, but you will never be able to catch them since they are quite fast and escape when you tried to catch them. Other than this you can go climb the hill upside to get a very amazing view of the surrounding ocean and island, but beware, the road is bad and sandy so it is very easy to…

Kelor Island is a small island in Indonesia's Komodo National Park, popular for its beautiful white sand beaches, clear waters, and stunning panoramic views from a steep, rocky hill. It is a frequent stop on tours from nearby Labuan Bajo, and activities include swimming, snorkeling, and a challenging but rewarding hike to the summit

Salt air, gentle breeze, and the sound of birds greeting the day. Kelor Island, you’re a dream come true. 🕊️🌴 The trek up kelor Island wasn’t easy steep paths, uneven steps, and legs that started to burn halfway up. The air was so clear and cool, and each step felt heavier than the last. But we kept going, side by side, with only the sound of our breathing and the faint rustle of wind through the hills. My best view…

2495.a: Loccal Collection Hotel, Jl. Binongko, Labuan Bajo, Komodo, West Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara 86554, Indonesia
2495.aj: Loccal Collection Hotel, Jl. Binongko, Labuan Bajo, Komodo, West Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara 86554 インドネシア
2495.ed: Chic hillside hotel featuring an infinity pool & sea views, plus a restaurant with a terrace.
2495.edj: 丘の中腹に位置するシックなホテル。インフィニティプールと海の景色、テラス付きレストランが魅力です。

rv.t: I had a really enjoyable stay at Loccal Collection Hotel Labuan Bajo. The hotel has a very unique and stylish concept, with architecture and design that stand out compared to typical hotels in the area. The atmosphere feels modern, aesthetic, and relaxing — perfect for a getaway in Labuan Bajo.One of the best parts of the stay was definitely the view. Overlooking the sea and surrounding hills, the scenery from the…

The view is definitely the best part of this place absolutely stunning and worth the visit. The staff were responsive and service was generally quick, but the process can feel a bit complicated for non-staying guests. The food took quite a long time to arrive, which was surprising considering one of our orders was a Vietnamese roll. 😅 Overall, a great spot to relax and enjoy the scenery. Come for the view, and…

We went there for food (and obviously for taking pictures), you can dine in even if you are not guests, but you have to purchase a coupon worth idr300k/person and your bill will be deducted from that value. If you spent less, they said they will return it, but well, we spent a lot so cannot comment on that. Oh the staffs are so nice, if you come alone, no one to take your pic? No worries, they will volunteer to take…

2496.a: Mirror Stone Cave, Labuan Bajo, Komodo, West Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia
2496.aj: Mirror Stone Cave, Labuan Bajo, Kec. Komodo, Kabupaten Manggarai Barat, Nusa Tenggara Tim., インドネシア

rv.t: I visited this cave today and had a great experience. As an international visitor, I paid 50,000(cash) to go in and 50,000 for a guide(mandatory) The entry is impressive with an air-conditioned souvenir shop, a ticket window and several outdoor food/drink stands, plus a foot massage stand! Everyone was lovely. The cave experience was good, tho too brief, but I did enjoy the tour and am glad I came here today! ❤️🫶❤️

Very interesting and beautiful cave! They provide helmets to enter a narrow trail, recommended to go in and have a look, not difficult at all. No guide needed as it is a round loop. Better than Rangko Cave

Surprisingly fun!! I actually considered not going here because the pictures looked quite average, but definitely worth a trip! It's quite a short tour (30-45m). I most enjoyed entering the cave with a helmet (which was essential as there were many spots to knock your head). It was quite the mini adventure.

2497.a: Pink Beach, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia
2497.aj: インドネシア ヌサトゥンガラティムール ピンクビーチ
2497.ed: Pale pink sandy beach with clear waters & reef teeming with tropical fish & some strong currents.

rv.t: The beach may not be as bright pink as some edited photos online, but its natural beauty is breathtaking. Clear water, great snorkeling, and a unique landscape make Pink Beach one of the highlights of Komodo. U also have a chance to see Deer 🦌 inside this island.

In my opinion the beach is not that much pink, because around labuan bajo area they had so many pink beach. The water is crystal clear so you can do light swim and sunbathing in the beach. So if you are hungry and thirsty you can order food at the food stall along the beach, but they only accept cash in IDR.

Pink Beach was one of the most breathtaking beaches I’ve ever seen. The water was crystal clear, calm, and perfect for swimming—easily one of the best swims of our trip. The beach itself was stunning, with its unique pink sand and beautiful surroundings. What made the experience even better was that it wasn’t crowded, allowing us to fully enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and natural beauty. A truly unforgettable place…

2498.a: OLLE Korean Restaurant, 新宿188ビル, B1F, 1 Chome-8-8 Hyakunincho, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 169-0073, Japan
2498.aj: 〒169-0073 東京都新宿区百人町１丁目８−８ 新宿188ビル B1F OLLE
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2498.ed: Diners like this restaurant's wide variety of delicious Korean dishes, especially the flavorful Nakkopuse, hearty Samgyeopsal, and fresh seafood. They also highlight the generous portions, good value, and free soft-serve ice cream. Guests mention the stylish, cave-like atmosphere and the friendly, attentive staff who sometimes play requested K-Pop music.
2498.edj: この韓国料理店を利用した人は、種類豊富な美味しい韓国料理を高く評価しています。特に、風味豊かなナッコプセ、食べ応えのあるサムギョプサル、新鮮な海鮮料理がおすすめとして挙げられています。また、ボリュームのある料理、手頃な価格設定、無料のソフトクリームも好評のようです。店内はスタイリッシュな洞窟のような雰囲気で、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフが、リクエストに応じてK-POP音楽を流してくれるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: The atmosphere is really good. Should be reserved in advance if you want to try Jeju in Tokyo!!!!!!

The food was good and full of flavor throughout. The menu system is handled with remarkable efficiency and logic. That said, I strongly recommend booking in advance and steering clear of the line for a table if you can—reservation holders are given clear priority, which can result in surprisingly long waits for walk-ins. The restaurant doesn't communicate this upfront, perhaps assuming it's common knowledge.
Best beer in the town!!!🍺 Also fish stew and steamed eggs were very nice I could eat endlessly

2499.a: Shobu-ike Pond, 444-2 Shibokusa, Oshino, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0511, Japan
2499.aj: 〒401-0511 山梨県南都留郡忍野村忍草４４４−２ 忍野八海 菖蒲池

rv.t: You can enjoy the perfect view of Mt.Fuji with the village view. There is also big souvenir shop and snacks stand. Although it is a bit pricey. The Tofu is definitely worth trying. For the kusa mochi, you can find the cheaper on the side road for cheaper price.

I went there by my parents and a friend. I have a super nice and good memory of visiting there. You can see Fuji when it is sunny and blue sky. The houses and the area are old and very traditional. So cooooll and nice. There are places to dine in and places to shop and buy presents and gifts. A must to visit
it’s better to visit here if it’s not raining hehe

2500.a: Nakaike Pond, Shibokusa, Oshino, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0511, Japan
2500.aj: 〒401-0511 山梨県南都留郡忍野村忍草中池
2500.ed: Visitors say this pond features incredibly clear, deep blue water where fish and plants are clearly visible, creating a beautiful and mystical atmosphere. They also highlight the surrounding souvenir shops and eateries, offering local treats like soba and dango. Guests mention it's a prime photo spot, especially with views of Mount Fuji and traditional thatched-roof buildings.
2500.edj: この池を訪れた人は、信じられないほど澄んだ深い青色の水が特徴だと評価しています。水中の魚や植物がはっきりと見え、美しく神秘的な雰囲気を醸し出しているようです。また、周囲にはお土産屋さんや飲食店が並び、そばや団子などの地元の味が楽しめるというクチコミもあります。富士山や伝統的な茅葺き屋根の建物が見えるため、絶好の撮影スポットとしても人気です。

rv.t: Nakaike Pond is probably the most eye-catching spot in Oshino Hakkai. It’s larger than the others and has that deep, clear blue color that really stands out. What makes it special is how lively the area feels around it. There are traditional houses, small shops, and people walking around, so it has more energy compared to the quieter ponds. At the same time, the water itself still feels calm and pure. You can see…
Very beautiful pond. The water is crystal clear and u could see all the way to the bottom. The water is coming from the mountains which explains it being so clear. Beautiful!
Peaceful and scenic spot with beautiful spring-fed ponds and amazing Mt. Fuji surroundings. Definitely worth visiting when in the area.

2501.a: Kagami-ike Pond, 339-2 Shibokusa, Oshino, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0511, Japan
2501.aj: 〒401-0511 山梨県南都留郡忍野村忍草３３９−２ 忍野八海 鏡池
2501.ed: Visitors say this pond offers beautifully scenic views, with Mount Fuji often perfectly mirrored in its clear water, making it a great spot for photos. They also highlight the peaceful atmosphere and convenient, reasonably priced parking options. Other reviews mention it can be very crowded.
2501.edj: この池を訪れた人は、富士山が水面にきれいに映り込む美しい景色を高く評価しており、写真撮影にぴったりの場所というクチコミが多くあります。また、静かで落ち着いた雰囲気や、手頃な料金で利用しやすい駐車場も好評のようです。 一方で、非常に混雑することがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: The Kagami-ike Pond in Oshino Hakkai is one of the spots that always has many tourists around and taking pictures. The pond is beautiful with the reflection of the buildings in it. The building is turned into a souvenir store with hundreds of people who want to buy something. I bought a few items here too! Lol!

Kagami-ike Pond is an absolute paradise that takes your breath away with its harmonious blend of a crystal-clear pond, the awe-inspiring silhouette of Mount Fuji, and a mesmerizing carpet of Sakura blossoms! As spring arrives, the pond transforms into a fairy-tale wonderland, bursting with vibrant pink and white cherry blossoms that reflect beautifully in the pristine waters, creating an enchanting and spellbinding…
First time in my life tasting natural water!!! The water is so cold!! Envy the people living nearby. What a great place to come.

2502.a: Okama-ike Pond, 114 Shibokusa, Oshino, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0511, Japan
2502.aj: 〒401-0511 山梨県南都留郡忍野村忍草１１４ 忍野八海 お釜池
2502.ed: Visitors say this pond features exceptionally clear, blue, and deep water, allowing for clear views of fish and aquatic plants. They also highlight its peaceful and calming atmosphere, making it a great spot for quiet reflection. Others mention it's a charming and picturesque natural spot, especially beautiful with the shifting light.
2502.edj: この池を訪れた人は、水が非常に澄んでいて青く、深いと評価しています。そのため、魚や水生植物がはっきりと見えるようです。また、穏やかで落ち着いた雰囲気があり、静かに物思いにふけるのに最適な場所だという声もあります。移り変わる光によって表情を変える、魅力的で絵のように美しい自然の場所だというクチコミも多くあります。

rv.t: Okama‑ike Pond is one of those quiet natural spots that feels peaceful the moment you arrive. The water has a stillness that makes the reflections look almost painted, and the surrounding greenery adds a soft, calming frame to the scene. Visiting on a weekday means the area stays quiet, giving you space to walk slowly and take in the details without feeling rushed. There’s no wait to enter, which keeps the…
Interesting. From afar it looks like a small pond. It is a small pond. But if you walk further in, you see the carps (at this point only) and it looks deep. Pretty reflections :))
It has great views of Mt. Fuji but the pond and surrounding tourist village is nothing special. There is some good Japanese street food available there though.

2503.a: Nigori-ike Pond, 360 Shibokusa, Oshino, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0511, Japan
2503.aj: 〒401-0511 山梨県南都留郡忍野村忍草３６０ 忍野八海 濁池

rv.t: Nigori-ike Pond is a beautiful and peaceful spot within Oshino Hakkai. What impressed me most was the crystal-clear water, allowing visitors to see the aquatic plants and rocks at the bottom of the pond. Surrounded by traditional Japanese houses, flowers, and lush greenery, the scenery feels like a living postcard. Even on a cloudy day, the pond remained incredibly beautiful and photogenic. The white daisies along…

Nigori Ike Pond is a hidden gem that offers a peaceful escape from the busy city atmosphere. Surrounded by beautiful natural scenery, the pond has a calm and tranquil ambiance that makes it perfect for relaxing, taking photographs, or simply enjoying a quiet moment. The reflections on the water and the changing colors of the surrounding landscape create a picturesque setting throughout the day. It’s an ideal spot…

Nigori‑ike Pond has a quieter, more understated presence compared to the more photographed ponds in Oshino Hakkai. The water here has a softer, slightly clouded appearance, which gives the pond a different mood — calmer, more muted, almost like a natural pause in the middle of the village. It’s the kind of spot where you don’t feel the need to rush; you just stand there for a moment and let the stillness settle in…

2504.a: Choshi-ike Pond, 265 Shibokusa, Oshino, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0511, Japan

2504.ed: Small, circular spring pond & cultural-heritage site where water bubbles up from the bottom.

rv.t: No ticket required cause nothing worth seeing. It’s just an ordinary pond
Chill and good weather, be careful if using 6. Somebody's iPhone is inside the pond.
This place just a Pond whats make it special is the backstory

Super clear water and very pretty little pond. cute fishes and so green here.
Ok

rv.t: Honcho 2-chome Shopping District – Iconic Shot, But Timing Matters 📸🚶‍♂️ This spot is known for that picture-perfect street view with Mount Fuji, and yes, it is very photogenic. However, we visited on a Sunday afternoon, and it was extremely crowded. The situation felt a bit chaotic, traffic was affected, local drivers were clearly not happy, and unfortunately not all visitors were respecting the rules. The traffic…

📍 Honcho 2-chome Shopping District ほんちょう２丁目商店街 @ Fujiyoshida, Yamanashi 🇯🇵 When we visited, the Honcho 2-chome Shopping District had a nostalgic, retro atmosphere, but most of the street shops were closed. Instead, the area outside was crowded with many people gathering to capture Mount Fuji 🗻 over the old street, which is now a very popular and iconic photo spot. Travellers, photographers, and visitors all waited…

The iconic old street with that Mt Fuji view !!!! There’s just something nostalgic with the old shops lining the street and THAT Mt Fuji view in the background…. This area has not yet become commercialised, and that’s so refreshing!

2507.aj: 〒403-0004 山梨県富士吉田市下吉田５丁目２５−９ もんぶらん
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2507.ed: Known for high-end pens, this chain also sells its own line of luxury watches, jewelry & more.
2507.edj: 高級筆記具の販売で知られるチェーン店。自社ブランドの高級腕時計、ジュエリーなども扱っている。

rv.t: I would give this restaurant more stars if I could! We went there twice, once to try out a few of the myriad of desserts they offer, and once again to try out a few of the myriad of pastas they offer (I have never seen such an exhaustive selection of items like this). Each time it was absolutely delicious. The staff here is really nice as well, and they seemed grateful that we came back a second time to eat there!…

Came here because of the TV series “Hotspot”. Amazingly lucky to be the last guest that will be served. We arrived there at 3pm and waited until 4:20pm to enter. The food and service were totally worth it! We also made friends with customers right in front of us. Take your time and just enjoy your time here!
The most adorable little cafe, where you're spoiled for choices for amazing parfaits! It's a teeny place, so I hope you get a seat 🤗

2508.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Yoshida udon, known for its chewy noodles and flavorful broth, and also enjoy the generous portions of fried chicken. 2508.edj: この食堂を利用した人は、もちもちとした麺と風味豊かな出汁が特徴の本格的な吉田うどんを高く評価しています。また、ボリュームたっぷりの唐揚げも人気です。手頃な価格と、居心地の良い昔ながらの雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフは親しみやすく、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: We came here twice and enjoyed very much udon, chasiu don and gyu don. It’s really value for money meals with Japanese sitting style and service. Highly recommended place to eat at Fujiyoshida.
"The chewiest udon you’ll ever have! 🥢 Experiencing the authentic taste of Fujiyoshida in a cozy, traditional atmosphere that feels just like dining at a friend’s home. 🏮"

Family run restaurant with delicious food. There was an English menu with photos, great for foreigners. Owner was very friendly. We had the Mount Fuji udon and fried chicken rice set. Affordable and tasty!

rv.t: Very traditional and down to earth restaurant. The udon is homemade!

うどん麺がふと硬いとのことでおじゃましてみました、 掘っ立て小屋をおもわせる雰囲気 店内はキャンプ場のバンガロー風 下駄箱は奥行き不足 そんななか ムサシうどん並を注文しました、 天ぷらが大きくびっくり サクサクで美味しくいただきました。 やはり麺は太くて硬い 並盛でお腹いっぱい スープはと言うとやさしい感じ はっきり言うと薄くて味がしない 出汁がきいていない 追出し調味料があれば嬉しい😄 ごちそう様でした。 店内もっときれいにリフォームされたらお客さま増えると思いますよ うどんの麺は美味しいですよ。

日本一硬いうどんを食べてきたよ 今回食べたのは ⚪︎ムサシうどん冷700円（税込） ⚪︎野菜天ぷら150円（税込） ⚪︎麺大盛り200円（税込） 山梨県富士吉田市の"吉田のうどん"は、日本一硬いとも言われるほど非常に強いコシと太麺が特徴の郷土料理です 𐩢𐩺 具材は茹でキャベツや馬肉などが定番らしいです 名古屋の味噌煮込みの硬い麺が好きなので、前々から吉田のうどんが食べたいとおもってて、ようやく食べることができました ･ᴗ･ この"ムサシ"さんは口コミとか見ると、吉田のうどんの中でも1、2を争う硬さらしく、 食べログうどんEAST 百名店に2020、2022年と2度選出されているみたいです 𐩢𐩺 冷やの方がさらに硬いと言うことで、冷やにしました 名古屋の味噌煮込みの麺を太麺にしたような感じでした もっちりと硬く、食べ終わる頃には顎が痛くなってました ･ᴗ･ 野菜の天ぷらは、ザクザクスナック菓子くらいザクザク！…

Also almost empty compared to Starbucks underneath so good place to…

Great window seat for the scramble crossing. ¥2500 per hour is apparently higher than it used to be but, being from the UK, I was happy with the price. Unlimited alcohol, soft and hot drinks, snacks etc. Would return again.

It was better last time with 1650 yen. Now they charge you 2500 yen with alcohol included but they hv removed all the microwaveable food, normal cofffee latte n not starbucks brand, no more frozen food, cheap snacks and bread. Unless you can really drink like 6 mugs at one go, otherwise I would say it is very expensive now. My last time.

2512.a: Japan, 〒107-0052 Tokyo, Minato City, Akasaka, 3 Chome−11−7 プロカンジャンケジャン赤坂店 ソシアル赤坂ビル2F

Old review 2017 Food: mainly crab 6 stars Atmosphere: 3. 5 we got a private room Up until I came here I didn’t know crab could be this delicious when raw Usually I ate them stir fried with ginger shallot or chilli mid crab or black pepper But the Koreans took crab to the next level, the taste is absolutely mind blowing and unforgettable. Must try the soy marinated crab ( Gangjang Gejang) or make it a regret. The raw…
Food is wonderful like it says on TV, but it’s not a non smoking restaurant. You will get 2nd hand smoked... if u don’t mind, just enjoy the food.

rude reception service - slow and bad english response. had ordered pancake and asked for why not serving after 20mins… he answered there is no pancake in a less hospital way. ok I thought yes and ordered more. then another 15mins, pancake came…. bad cold dishes, stir fried beef tasted too dry and dishwash smell….. never be here if I go a table nearby, avoid if u search a meaningful Korean dinner.

2514.a: Komaruyama Observatory, Tokorono, Nikko, Tochigi 321-1421, Japan
2514.aj: 〒321-1421 栃木県日光市所野小丸山展望台
catj: ハイキング コース

rv.t: Great view as far as the clouds allow, definitely go on a day with as little fog or clouds as possible. It is quite the hike up all the stairs, but well worth it. There are also side hiking paths that are nice, and paths higher up into the mountains.
Keep climbing. The view is worth your effort. Just take a deep breath and go slowly.
Pretty view from the top despite slight fog. Make sure to bring a raincoat because the peak is always in the clouds

2515.a: Lucky Pierrot Hakodate Ekimae branch, ２階 8-8 Wakamatsucho, Hakodate, Hokkaido 040-0063, Japan
2515.aj: 〒040-0063 北海道函館市若松町８−８ ２階 ラッキーピエロ 函館駅前店
2515.ed: People say this burger joint offers delicious, hearty burgers like the Chinese chicken burger, and a wide variety of other menu items such as omurice and curry. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the unique, fun atmosphere. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
2515.edj: クチコミによると、このハンバーガー店は、チャイニーズチキンバーガーをはじめとする美味しくてボリュームのあるハンバーガーを提供しており、オムライスやカレーなど、他にも様々なメニューが豊富に揃っていると評判です。また、手頃な価格とユニークで楽しい雰囲気が特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、サービスが非効率的だと感じるクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Important rules to follow: ~Line up if there is a queue. There is no sign in. Just wait inline for your turn! ~Order FIRST, THEN get a seat. There's dozens of signs everywhere that say this in ENGLISH and Japanese. Don't be that idiot in the other Google review who couldn't read and walked out to his own stupidity. ~Once done ordering, they'll give you a yellow tag with a number and a slip for you to write down the…

I went around 10 AM and was able to line up, order food and choose a table without too much trouble. For the Chinese chicken burger I really liked the bun, it was soft and smelled really nice. The fried chicken was hot and tasty too, but the sauce was a little sweeter than I expected. The Chinese chicken curry was really good. The curry sauce was rich and flavorful and it went perfectly with the rice and chicken…

A truly unique spot with good food; we visited because we heard it’s a chain very popular with the locals. We ordered the most popular item: the Chinese chicken burger, and I have to say, it’s a really good hamburger. They also offer a wide range of dishes, including Japanese style options. It’s a very interesting and fun place to try if you happen to be in Hakodate.

2516.a: Kusatsu Onsen Hotel Village, 618番地 Kusatsu, Agatsuma District, Gunma 377-1711, Japan
2516.aj: 〒377-1711 群馬県吾妻郡草津町草津618番地 草津温泉ホテルヴィレッジ
catj: アミューズメント センター
2516.ed: Hot spring resort with airy rooms, stylish condos & log cabins, plus a wellness spa, dining & pools.
2516.edj: 広々とした客室、スタイリッシュなコンドミニアム、ログハウスを備えた温泉リゾート。ウェルネススパ、レストラン、プールを併設。

rv.t: Sorry to say but for me, I did not like this hotel. It's OLD! It's outdated, it's dirty, it's far from center (shuttle bus, yes but stops too early and no taxis too), the onsen was ok and the hot water event/show was slightly interesting, the room's bath and floor stained and faded, the door did not close properly or completely without effort, the staff's uniforms were also old and outdated, I bet this place was…

I truly believe that if you wanna have onsen like locals and this is the place! The room that I booked I thought choose between western or Japanese style and came out to be our room having two. And one jacuzzi. It’s a very big room for two. However it’s old and needs to be replaced for better experience.

A special shoutout to Akuzawa for her excellent service. Upon my arrival at hotel, she guided me through the entire check-in process in perfect English, with the warm and attentive hospitality that Japan is known for. She also took the time to explain the hotel facilities and shared helpful suggestions on places to visit in Kusatsu, which I appreciated as it was my first time here. The room was comfortable, and the…

2517.a: Imabari Station, 1-chōme-1 Nakahiyoshichō, Imabari, Ehime 794-0055, Japan
2517.aj: 〒794-0055 愛媛県今治市中日吉町１丁目１ 今治駅
2517.ed: People say this station is clean and well-maintained, offering convenient access to rental cycles and a tourist information center. They also highlight the polite and helpful staff at the ticket counter. Other reviews mention the ticketing system can be inconvenient.
2517.edj: クチコミによると、この駅は清潔で手入れが行き届いていると評判で、レンタサイクルや観光案内所へのアクセスも便利です。また、切符売り場のスタッフは丁寧で親切だという声が多くあります。 一方で、切符の購入システムが不便だというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: What backwater train station in Japan in the year of our lord 2026 does not have IC cards? I could somewhat forgive it if the ticketing system was okay, but no, that’s bad too. You have to select the fare price instead of the destination, which is impossible without already knowing or having the Google Maps fare info on hand. Two unforgivable lapses in intelligence by management that wouldn’t even take a lot of…

Took the limited express train to Matsuyama after finish cycling on Shimanami Kaido. I had a Setouchi JR pass, it is usable at this station and Matsuyama station. I got lucky and witness saw the Anpan man train which I frequently watch in my childhood days. 😊 Visited at 29 Mar 2025
I wasn't expecting to go to Imabari on this trip, but I decided to one afternoon. While my trip to Imabari was very limited (I only went to see the castle). The station was really nice and clean.

2518.a: Arakurayama Sengen Park, 2-chome-4-1 Asama, Fujiyoshida, Yamanashi 403-0011, Japan
2518.aj: 〒403-0011 山梨県富士吉田市浅間２丁目４−１ 新倉山浅間公園
2518.ed: Park with many stairs leading to seasonal cherry blossoms, a pagoda & dramatic views of Mt. Fuji.
2518.edj: 春の花見スポットへと続く階段、忠霊塔、富士山の眺望で知られる公園。

rv.t: Many people think the biggest challenge here is whether Mount Fuji will be visible. In reality, the bigger challenge may be finding a spot to stand once you get to the top. On cloudy days, you might not see Mount Fuji at all. On clear days, however, you’ll be sharing the view with what feels like half the world’s photographers and tourists. It’s not unusual to arrive at the observation deck and find people already…

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Arakurayama Sengen Park was one of the most iconic and rewarding viewpoints from the entire Japan trip. The climb up the stairs can be a bit tiring, but once you reach the top, the view makes it completely worth the effort. Seeing the famous pagoda with Mount Fuji in the background felt surreal and looked exactly like the classic postcard images of Japan. The park was clean, peaceful and very well…

Arakurayama Sengen Park is one of Japan’s most iconic viewpoints and offers the classic postcard-style panorama of Mount Fuji together with the striking Chureito Pagoda overlooking the city below. The combination of traditional Japanese architecture, mountain scenery, and seasonal nature creates a view that is both dramatic and unmistakably Japanese. The park is part of the historic Arakura Fuji Sengen Shrine…

2519.a: Senryuji, 1 Chome-6-1 Motoizumi, Komae, Tokyo 201-0013, Japan
2519.aj: 〒201-0013 東京都狛江市元和泉１丁目６−１ 雲松山 泉龍寺

rv.t: The grounds of the temple are really small and attached to a cemetery. The despite quite pretty, it is very common if you’ve been around Japan. Not worth a detour to see, but if you’re in the neighborhood come in.
Very nice and calm place. Early august - garden is full of pink lily.

妻と二人で雨の中参拝してきました。 狛江駅から徒歩数分という立地ながら、境内に一歩足を踏み入れると、街の喧騒がすっと遠ざかるような静かで厳かな空間が広がっています。 まず目を引くのは二階建ての立派な楼門。そのどっしりとした佇まいは、駅前のお寺とは思えない存在感があります。 さらに境内を進むと、大規模な本堂が現れます。荘厳な建物ですが、正面は全面がガラス張りになっており、重厚さの中にもどこか親しみやすさを感じました。 背の高い木々に囲まれた広い境内は、雨の日ということもあって一層落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれていました。濡れた石畳や木々の緑も美しく、まるで山寺を訪れたような気持ちになります。 御朱印は書き置きをいただきました。 駐車場の案内はホームページには見当たりませんでしたが、狛江駅側の入口左手には駐車可能なスペースがあります。ただ、駅前という立地でもあり、長時間の駐車は控えた方がよさそうです。…
